heroLede: Professional title and settlement services for purchase and refinance transactions — secure, accurate, and straightforward from the opened order through recording.

pillars.title: Accurate
pillars.text: Title orders are opened with the documents the file requires, beginning with the sale agreement on a purchase.

pillars.title: Secure
pillars.text: Lenders, agents, and clients exchange documents through Qualia, the secure portal ITG uses for the closing.

pillars.title: Responsive
pillars.text: Client care, processing, and post-closing each have a dedicated team, so your questions go directly to the people handling your file.

servicesLede: Real estate transactions turn on documents, deadlines, and funds. ITG stays with the file from the first order to the recording process.
audienceHeading: The people at the closing table.

audiences.label: Home buyers
audiences.text: A purchase file opens with the sale agreement. ITG’s client-care and processing teams use that contract to start the title order, then stay with the file through settlement.

audiences.label: Home sellers
audiences.text: Sellers are part of the same purchase settlement. The sale agreement starts the order, and post-closing carries funding, recording, and the document audit after signing.

audiences.label: Homeowners refinancing
audiences.text: Refinance orders are opened on their own. If you are still comparing fees, request a pre-closing disclosure before the file is treated as an opened order.

audiences.label: Real estate agents
audiences.text: Agents send purchase and refinance orders, with the sale agreement on a purchase. Qualia is the secure portal for documents once the file is underway.

audiences.label: Lenders
audiences.text: Lenders share that same portal with agents and clients. Processing handles the open file, including complicated matters, and post-closing takes funding and recording.

processHeading: From the opened order to recording.

steps.title: Order opened
steps.text: Client care opens a purchase or refinance order. On a purchase, the sale agreement should come with the request so processing is not waiting on basic information.

steps.title: Title processing
steps.text: A processor is assigned and works the file, including complicated matters. Questions about the open order go to the processing desk.

steps.title: Review and preparation
steps.text: The file is prepared for settlement. If you are still comparing fees, a pre-closing disclosure can be requested before the order moves ahead.

steps.title: Closing
steps.text: The parties sign and the transaction is settled. The office remains available for questions through that signing.

steps.title: Recording and completion
steps.text: Post-closing handles funding, recording, and a document audit, with authorization and layered verification.

aboutLead: Integrity Title Group is a Maryland title and settlement office. The practice was established by real estate professionals and draws on more than 30 years of combined title experience.
aboutBody: Client care is the first point of contact. Processing is responsible for the open order. Post-closing handles funding, recording, and the document audit. Each stage has an assigned team.

reasons.title: Integrity
reasons.text: The work is organized around the client’s transaction, with a first point of contact and a team that stays through recording.

reasons.title: Attention to detail
reasons.text: Purchase orders start with the sale agreement. Complicated files stay with processors who are assigned to them.

reasons.title: Responsive service
reasons.text: Each stage has a designated address: orders, processing, pre-closing disclosures, and post-closing. Inquiries are directed to the team responsible for that stage.

reasons.title: Smooth closings
reasons.text: A file proceeds from opening through processing, signing, funding, and recording.

coverageText: Title and settlement services are offered in Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Delaware, Indiana, Ohio, Kentucky, North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida, and New Jersey. Contact the office before submitting an order for a property outside this list. Assistance elsewhere may be available through partner relationships and is not guaranteed.
ctaHeading: Open an order or request a quote.
ctaText: Send a purchase or refinance request, ask for a quote, or call 443.725.7020. Do not include account numbers or wire instructions in a website message.
